title: Cave Dweller Delight
description: A Cave Dweller Addon which works with Farmer's Delight, allowing you to kill and cook most cave dweller mobs, provided they use the "cave_dweller" mob ID.
body:
Cave Dweller Delight
Ever found that most cave dweller mods don't feel finished or polished? That most of the time you can kill one and it doesn't feel rewarding because usually there are no drops, essentially making it useless? Well I thought that too so I looked at Farmer's Delight and thought.. What if you eat one?

Cave Dweller Head design is not by me. You can find the original model Here. Everything else is designed, coded and modelled by me. Cave Dweller is a Mob made by Gargin.

Features
Unique Cave Dweller Drops
Killing the Cave Dweller now drops a Cave Dweller leg which you can cook into a large array of food from Pastys in the Crafting Table or a Pie in the Cooking Pot. Or place the Cave Dweller Leg on a cutting board to make a new weapon!

Survival-Friendly Progression
The idea of this mod was to make this feel rewarding upon killing a cave dweller! And such there's new advancements and reasons to try to farm these monsters.

Modpack Friendly
Built for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1, it works with any mob that contains the "Cave_Dweller" ID Tag in the code, essentially working on most mod reskins, as there are plenty. It has virtually no hard dependencies, not even to Farmer's Delight even though that removes recipes. So go wild!

Compile Only Meaning to only activate a head slot if Curios is active. Not dependant

Compatibility
Minecraft 1.20.1
Forge Mod Loader
Singleplayer & Multiplayer
Modpack Friendly
Works with Most Cave_Dweller mobs
Curios Compatibility
Why Use Cave Dweller Delight?
Most Cave Dweller encounters end with players running for their lives.

Cave Dweller Delight gives players a reason to stand their ground.

Face the darkness, hunt the hunter, collect unique drops, and transform your hard-earned trophies into new food items and rewards. Whether you're building a horror-themed modpack or simply want more reasons to explore the depths, Cave Dweller Delight adds fresh objectives and meaningful progression to every cave expedition.
